title: Volcanic Ash
description: Plain-text reference on what volcanic ash is and its health hazards, preparing your home and supplies, and staying safe during ashfall, including driving. Covers protecting lungs, eyes, and skin, clearing roofs and disposing of ash, and concerns for water, children, pets, and electronics.
shortDescription: Protect your lungs, eyes, home, car, and water during and after ashfall
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
